56.evidenceText: Three distinct inner tube models with SCV (Schwalbe Clik Valve): 12-EL (26"), 14-EL (27.5"), and 7-AP (20"). Each listing explicitly states "Valve: SCV"
56.extractionRationale: Source 1 explicitly lists three inner tube SKUs with SCV valve designation: 12-EL (EXTRA LIGHT for 26"), 14-EL (EXTRA LIGHT for 27.5"), and 7-AP (AIR PLUS for 20"). These are the only specific inner tube models with Clik valve interface identified in the provided evidence. Sources 2-5 discuss the Clik Valve technology but do not list additional specific tube models.
